description.value: A developed BC Parks campground at the scenic confluence of the Clearwater and North Thompson Rivers, 5 km south of Clearwater just off Highway 5 — easy access and proximity to Wells Gray Park make it a natural touring stopover. Gate closes off-season; flood-season currents June–July warrant water caution.

address.value: 5 km south of Clearwater, just off Highway 5, BC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is a BC Parks campground at the confluence of the Clearwater and North Thompson Rivers, located 5 km south of Clearwater on Highway 5. The site explicitly mentions cycling (bicycles must keep to roadways) and notes e-bikes are restricted to park roads only. Food is confirmed nearby in Clearwater. Reservations are supported via the 'Book camping' link. OSM tags provide phone and email; the website content does not display a phone number so phone cannot be confirmed. No mention of hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, shelters, or other amenities on the website.
concerns: E-bikes are not allowed on park trails, only on park roads — important for e-bike touring cyclists to know
OSM tag internet_access=no suggests limited electrical infrastructure; device/e-bike charging unlikely but unconfirmed
No address in OSM; address field constructed from website directions
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A well-established BC Parks campground directly on Highway 5, a major north-south cycling corridor. Convenient for touring cyclists with nearby services in Clearwater and easy highway access.
enrichment_extras.notes: Website explicitly notes: 'Bicycles with electric assist motors (e-bikes) are not allowed on the trails within North Thompson River Park. E-bikes are restricted to park roads and areas where motorized use is permitted.'
